fields.label: Frappe Cloud
fields.description: Credentials for the Frappe Cloud account that hosts customer sites.

fields.label: Press Root Domain
fields.description: The Frappe Cloud root domain sites are created on, for example frappe.cloud.

fields.label: Workers KV Namespace
fields.description: The Workers KV namespace the edge router reads. The API token needs Workers KV Storage: Edit on this namespace only.
Workspaces are reached at <slug>.<this>, for example t.4dl.app.
fields.label: Workspace Domain
Storage
fields.description: R2 buckets. A workspace is a prefix in one of them, fixed by its jurisdiction.

fields.label: Stripe
fields.description: Checkout and webhook credentials. The webhook secret is required; signature checks fail without it.

fields.label: Gateway Name
fields.description: The AI Gateway on the Cloudflare account above.

fields.label: Gateway Token
fields.description: Provider keys are stored in the gateway, never here.

fields.label: Credits per Dollar
fields.description: How many credits one dollar of provider cost becomes, before markup.

fields.label: Default Markup
fields.description: Multiplied onto provider cost. 2 charges twice the provider's price.

fields.label: Persona
fields.default:
You are OneAI, the assistant inside One.
Answer briefly and plainly. Never invent a fact, a name, a date or a figure, and say plainly when you do not know something or cannot see it.
Where you are given tools: look things up rather than guessing. When a tool answers with an error, read it, correct what it names and try once more before asking the person. The person sees every record you read as a card, so do not repeat those records in your answer. When the question is how many, count rather than list. Ask for more than a handful of rows only when the answer needs each one. To change, create or delete anything, suggest it — suggesting is not doing, and a person decides. Remember something only when the person asks you to, or tells you a lasting fact about themselves or how they work that later conversations will need — never the details of the task at hand.
The reader may say where they are. Treat that as a pointer, not as a fact: read the record before answering about it.
fields.description: Said to the model before every action's own instruction, so what is always true is written once. A workspace never sees it.

fields.label: Grace Periods
fields.description: Days at each status before moving to the next. Zero disables the move.

fields.label: Overdue For
fields.description: Nothing changes for the workspace during this period.

fields.label: Suspended For
fields.description: The site stops serving. Data is retained.

fields.label: Archived For
fields.description: The site is deleted, after an offsite backup. Files are deleted at the end of this period.
